reviews.comment: Gives feedback that often contradicts her own words, is impossible to please, and will love your design one day and hate it the next.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Weiling might seem nice, but she is a bipolar nightmare. She is rude and apathic. She told me she was not going to let me pass the class just because she didn't like one of my drawings (even though one week earlier she was talking about how much she liked my diagrams). AVOID HER AT ALL COST.
Loves everything about being abstract, but will be such a tough grader if her perspective did not match yours. She gets irritated after too many questions are asked by the class.

can be nice occasionally, but overall its hard to learn from her. gets annoyed & snaps when asked too many questions. CONSTNATLY changes her mind. if you follow her requests and she changes her mind midway, she will be extremely condescending and treat YOU like an idiot. calls herself "blunt" as an excuse to insult students and their work.

seemed nice at first but her attitude changed quickly when she didnt like a design or when you couldnt read her mind. she would snap at you for asking too many questions and changed her mind constantly, making it very hard to learn. prided herself in grading harshly for no reason. if you want nice work for your portfolio, dont take her.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Of all of the professors I've taken she's given me the most trouble, she doesn't know how to convey her ideas properly, she's always changing her mind. WARNING: She gets randomly upset at students, and projects her own feelings on them.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Weiling never gives you a straightforward answer when she's critiquing you, she asks you to change your project last minute and then she ends up hating her own critique ideas. 𝗕𝗘𝗪𝗔𝗥𝗘 Weiling is notorious for being the worst teacher at TAMU's Architecture program, she has a total of 8 students in her class mind you other profs have 30-40

Weiling is extremely knowledgeable in the field and wants nothing more than to see her students succeed. She can come off as strict or harsh until you understand her critique style and realize that she gives as much feedback as she can with the expectation that you will complete some of it. Her emphasis is on learning and even rest.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Weiling was one of the worst professors I have encountered. She changes her mind every critique and doesn't communicate what she is trying to teach well. When it comes to design she isn't very realistic and because she changes her mind so much, it causes you to do a lot of work for nothing. I cannot say that I have learned much from her teaching.
Do not take her unless you want a horrible time as a first year ARCH student

weiling is tough, theres no getting around that and if youre looking to have an easy way out of studio this isnt it. however, she pushes your abilities and is there to guide you through. shes honest, be ready for that bc she wont hold back and frankly doesn't care if youre feelings are hurt. she makes it a priority to meet with students though

Weiling is a great professor for anyone who appreciates good feedback, listens and responds to commentary, and shows up prepared. Her comments may not be gentle, but they are meant with love and when acted upon can make for an incredible learning experience. Also, she is very respectful of students' lives outside of architecture.

As a first year architecture student, I expected my professor to provide more guidance and instruction. Weiling does not give clear instruction, though I do know my work should be original, the basic instructions and critique are very confusing. She is very harsh and usually just insults your project rather than giving constructive criticism.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Professor He is an amazing professor; however she makes you work for it. She is incredibly truthful when critiquing your projects and does not hold anything back. However, she will take the time to help you improve if you show her you really want to. Her style of teaching takes a little bit to adjust to, but you will learn a lot when you do adjust

Weiling is not gonna let you slack in her studio and if you do she will not pay attention to your project. Is pretty hard for a freshman studio professor but you learn a lot about form and space. Does not have conventional projects but trust her process. Is not afraid to tell someone their project is trash, if it is. I am very glad I had her.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: She teaches the concepts well but is very meticulous during projects. Craftsman ship on projects is key. She also has a acquired taste that you will recognize quickly in the class.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Not a Bad Prof. for studio. Would recommend her any day. She is an acquired taste, but great when you get to know her. Personally the studio was pretty sluggish, but if you are willing to push yourself, you can build a good portfolio piece, cause she specializes in making sure all small details and construction methods work and are logical.

she was terrible with some people and super great with other ones, she likes to much abstract stuff. I don't recommend her to anyone. Besides sometimes she can be really rude if she doesn't like what you are doing. She expects too much from everybody.

This class made me to be undecided about to continue in this major.She does not have to much patience.I don't think I learned enough with her.She likes to do a lot of abstract things (plastic bags).That project took more than the half of the semester. I felt that she only took interest in some projects,she did not put the same effort to all them.

This was my first architecture class. I'm not going to lie, Weiling is pretty tough, but the amount that you learn from her is unreal and furthered my interest in architecture. She definitely weeds people out. Four students dropped out of my class of fifteen. She like very zen-like architecture (right angles and simplicity).
